data.name: Matlubah
data.gender_notes: Matlubah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is desiring or longing for something. The name Matlubah carries the meaning “Desiring” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Matlubah usually hope their child will grow to embody desiring and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes a deep longing or yearning for spiritual growth and enlightenment
data.etymology: Matlubah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Desiring.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Matlubah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: مطلوبة
in_arabic.meaning: المرغوبة، المطلوبة، ذات الجمال الخاطف للقلوب
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، يعني المرغوبة، المطلوبة، ذات الجمال الخاطف للقلوب. وقد وردت هذه الكلمة في القرآن الكريم في سورة الفاتحة، الآية ٥، 'إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِينُ'، أي المطلوبة من الله تعالى. وتستخدم هذه التسمية في الثقافة الإسلامية للإشارة إلى الفتاة الجميلة التي يطلبها الجميع.

in_urdu.name: مطلوبہ
in_urdu.meaning: مرغوبہ، مطلوبہ، خوبصورتی جو دل کو موہ لیتی ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: عربی मूल کا ایک نسائی نام، جس کا مطلب ہے مرغوبہ، مطلوبہ، خوبصورتی جو دل کو موہ لیتی ہے۔ یہ لفظ قرآن مجید میں فاتحہ کی سورت، آیت ٥ میں آیا ہے، 'إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِينُ'، یعنی اللہ تعالیٰ سے مطلوبہ۔ یہ تسمہ اسلامی ثقافت میں اس لڑکی کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو خوبصورت ہو اور سب کی درخواست پر ہو。

in_hindi.name: मطلूба
in_hindi.meaning: मांगनी, प्रियतमा, जो दिल को मोह लेती है
in_hindi.long_meaning: यह एक स्त्रीलिंग नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है मांगनी, प्रियतमा, जो दिल को मोह लेती है। कुरआन में यह शब्द फातिहा की सूरा, आयत ५ में आया है, 'إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِينُ', यानी जो अल्लाह से प्रिय हो। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में उस लड़की के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो सुंदर और प्रिय होती है।

in_pashto.name: مطلوبه
in_pashto.long_meaning: دې د ښځينه نوم دی چی عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، معنی یې ده غوښتل شوې، مینه والا، ښکلې. دا کلمه په قرآن کریم کې د فاتحې سورت، آیت ٥ کې راغلی ده، 'إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِينُ'، یعنی د الله تعالی څخه غوښتل شوې. دا تسمه په افغان او پښتني کلتور کې د ښکلې او مینه والا نجلې لپاره کارول کیږي.

in_english.name: Matlubah
in_english.long_meaning: Matlubah is a feminine given name of Arabic origin, meaning 'desired, beloved, captivating beauty'. Etymologically derived from the Arabic root 'ṭ-l-b', which conveys the sense of seeking or requesting. This name is mentioned in the Quran, Surah Al-Fatihah, verse 5, implying one who is sought or desired by Allah. Historically, the name has been used across Islamic cultures to signify a girl of exceptional beauty and spiritual significance, embodying qualities of love, compassion, and divine grace.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Matlubah" may carry the cultural significance of a person who is deeply passionate, dedicated, and determined to achieve a particular goal or dream. This could translate into a strong work ethic, focus, and determination in various aspects of life such as education, career, and personal relationships.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Matlubah" can represent a divine longing or yearning towards Allah or the pursuit of spiritual enlightenment. It can also serve as a reminder to always strive for closeness to Allah and to keep oneself on the righteous path towards seeking His pleasure. This constant longing and desire for the divine can lead to a more meaningful and fulfilling life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Desiring" symbolizes One who is desiring or longing for something. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Matlubah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of desiring.
